# AudioInfo { #timetoalign.loader.AudioInfo }

```python
loader.AudioInfo(
    n_samples,
    sample_rate,
    channels,
    duration_seconds,
    format,
    subtype=None,
    bits_per_sample=None,
    source_path=None,
    extra=dict(),
)
```

Metadata for an audio file.

This dataclass holds all relevant information about an audio file
that is needed to create a DiscretePhysicalTimeline.

Attributes:
    n_samples: Total number of samples in the file (frames).
    sample_rate: Sample rate in Hz (e.g., 44100, 48000).
    channels: Number of audio channels (1=mono, 2=stereo).
    duration_seconds: Duration in seconds (computed from n_samples/sample_rate).
    format: Audio format/codec (e.g., "WAV", "FLAC", "MP3").
    subtype: Audio subtype/encoding (e.g., "PCM_16", "PCM_24", "VORBIS").
    bits_per_sample: Bit depth (e.g., 16, 24, 32). May be None for lossy formats.
    source_path: Path to the source file.
    extra: Additional format-specific metadata.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [is_mono](#timetoalign.loader.AudioInfo.is_mono) | Whether the audio is mono (single channel). |
| [is_stereo](#timetoalign.loader.AudioInfo.is_stereo) | Whether the audio is stereo (two channels). |
| [length_in_samples](#timetoalign.loader.AudioInfo.length_in_samples) | Alias for n_samples, matching timeline terminology. |
